# Maitreyi | Product Designer

## Profile
Maitreyi is a product designer interested in human behavior and psychology, with a practice spanning research, interaction design, design systems, AI products, and working code prototypes. She is interested in owning ambiguous problems from discovery through implementation.

## Selected work

### Super Agent, Loop
Focus: behavioral research, agentic interactions, design systems.
Summary: bringing four specialized AI products into one conversational entry point, so users do not need to choose an assistant before asking a question.
Case study: https://uxmaitreyii.framer.website/super-agent

### Connect, Loop
Focus: onboarding, information architecture, reusable interaction patterns.
Summary: organizing 22 different workflows into six reusable patterns for an ecosystem of more than 50 data connectors.
Case study: https://uxmaitreyii.framer.website/connect

## AI experiments
Three experiments will be added. No experiment content, names, or results have been published on this portfolio yet.

## About
Maitreyi studies behavior and psychology to understand the person behind the screen. She uses design fundamentals to create clear experiences, and code and AI-assisted tools to build and test ideas. Outside work, she enjoys exploring hobbies, planning treasure hunts for friends, and side projects.
